method: No browser visit was made on 30 October 2026, because his record in people.json carries no Kaggle handle (its only account is X, fchollet) and so no Kaggle profile can be attributed to him from the record. The earlier draft of this file, written while Kaggle was blocking us, was treated as unverified and none of its Kaggle claims are repeated. What was read instead: the ARC Explainer Hall of Fame contributor entry as served by the site's own public contributors data endpoint (the data the Hall of Fame page renders from; the rendered page itself was not opened), the public GitHub repository record for fchollet/ARC-AGI (the repository the Hall of Fame entry links), and his local portrait file. One request to X's public embed endpoint for his profile picture was answered with a rate-limit refusal and was not retried.

facts.text: The ARC Explainer Hall of Fame describes François Chollet, creator of Keras, as the person who defined the ARC-AGI benchmark in 2019 to measure general intelligence.
facts.sourceTitle: ARC Explainer Hall of Fame — ARC Prize founders entry

facts.text: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus repository, ARC-AGI, is hosted on GitHub under his own fchollet account, and the Hall of Fame entry links to it.
